output.interpretation: Vendor notice states the field-dispatch v2 route-push endpoint was retired on 2026-10-01 and any route push must use v3. This is a technical integration constraint on the field-dispatch system itself, not evidence bearing on the billing-dispute causal chain (read collection, billing import, estimate substitution).

contradiction_assessment.rationale: The notice concerns the field-dispatch API's route-push protocol version, not any premise of PD-1's root problem (billing-import rejection of actual reads, E-12) or its causal chain; it has no bearing on the current dispute-surge analysis.

vob_proposals.unresolved_question: Does any future push_route_update call against field-dispatch (K-DISPATCH) target the v3 endpoint, given v2 was retired 10-01?
vob_proposals.validation_method: Confirm with ORG-FIELD/vendor integration that the route-push call path uses the v3 endpoint before executing any push_route_update action.
required_evidence: Vendor/ORG-FIELD confirmation that route-push integration uses v3 endpoint
vob_proposals.rationale: push_route_update is a defined protected action (K-DISPATCH, DA-PUSH-ROUTE-UPDATE); using the retired v2 endpoint would make any such action fail, so this should be checked if that action is ever invoked.
